subject: POC launch week coordination and workshop slot (proposal + load plan)
messages:
From: Mira Patel <mira@finidex.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@finidex.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Introduction + proposed POC week and goals

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was excited about the latency and routing controls. We are ready to lock in a short POC to validate prompt routing and a light load run (target ~50 rps peak for 30 minutes).

High-level goals from our side:
- Confirm prompt routing and fallbacks for our multi-intent flows
- Validate KV cache behavior with 8k context prompts
- Run a small load window to capture p95/p99 latencies and token cost numbers

Stakeholders who should be in the kickoff: Mira Patel (PM, product), Rajiv Menon (platform lead), and Elena Gomez (security). We can allocate engineer time for the load day if needed.

Are you available the week of Oct 12 for a 60–90 minute kickoff plus a separate 90 minute lab session? If so, please propose a couple of slots — we prefer mornings PT.

Thanks,
Mira
Mira Patel
Head of Product, Finidex
M: 415-555-0118
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Mira Patel <mira@finidex.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@finidex.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Introduction + proposed POC week and goals

Hi Mira — great to hear. Thanks for the clear goals.

Proposed plan:
1) 60-minute kickoff (stakeholder intros, success criteria, roles) — agenda attached (Redwood_POC_Agenda_v1.pdf)
2) 90-minute lab session a separate day (prompt review, routing config, small load window) — see attached load plan (finidex-load-plan.xlsx)

Suggested kickoff slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 13, 9:00–10:00
- Wed Oct 14, 11:00–12:00
- Thu Oct 15, 9:30–10:30

For the lab/load day, we recommend planning a 2-hour slot where we reserve a 30–45 minute peak window (we'll run an agreed script). Please confirm whether Rajiv's infra team can allow a test origin from our dedicated demo endpoint (we'll share IP ranges).

Quick asks before kickoff:
- Can Elena share any particular compliance items she wants validated during the run? (data retention window, logs sampling, redaction rules)
- A sample prompt set (10–20 examples) to review routing rules ahead of time

I'll hold the Tue and Thu slots tentatively and send a calendar invite once you confirm attendees and preferred time.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
A: +1 650-555-2244
